Match the attached reference's exquisite Apple first-party Liquid Glass studio render quality and turquoise material. Full bleed smooth background gradient deep teal #0E3A44 top to ink navy #0B1426 bottom, no vignette, no grain, no stars. One optically centered bold composition occupying about 60-65% of canvas with generous margins. 2-3 layered frosted translucent turquoise glass material surfaces, crisp restrained specular top edges, refraction, soft contact shadows, smooth top studio lighting. Persian turquoise #2EC4D6 with pale cyan highlights and #128A9A shadows, warm white, tiny soft burnished gold accents only. Authentic Persian calligraphy and manuscript ornament. No neon glow, cheap plastic, surrounding frame, rounded canvas corners, Latin text, watermark, devices, mockups or clutter. Subject: An open Persian manuscript divan of poetry, slightly viewed from above, made from 2-3 stacked layers of frosted translucent glass pages. Each of the TWO open pages has TWO columns of short abstract horizontal warm white strokes, aligned into paired hemistichs of couplets, with a narrow gutter between the columns. Approximately six paired rows per page. These are clean abstract strokes, NOT readable text or fake calligraphic squiggles. At top of pages a small authentic turquoise and gold Persian illuminated sarlowh headpiece with tiny shamseh medallion. Minimal restrained illumination. Strong simple open-book silhouette that reads at small size. Gold accent only, no elaborate busy decoration. Generate only this one icon.
